ask: My costs have gone up a lot this year and I have my own mortgage to cover, so I need £1,450 a month from the renewal. Can you confirm that is OK?
text:

We’ve paid on time every month for the past three years. Given that record, would you be willing to keep the rent at £1,250 a month? We’d be happy to confirm a full year at that rate.
